text:
The CS stage collapsed because its output DC came from an open-loop current balance. The PMOS-gate network did not replicate the main branch, so a ~25% current error drove M1 into triode. This fix makes the bias branch an exact scaled replica of the main branch.

- M6 is the input-device replica: same L as M1, carrying iref, sized so Vgs ≈ 0.75 V.
- M5 and M3 are scaled copies of M1 and M2. They set pb so that Vout ≈ pb = VDD − Vsg.

Vout then lands at about VDD − Vsg wherever that is, instead of depending on matched absolute currents. All current goes into one device for gm/power efficiency.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vout collapsed: open-loop current balance mismatched. Use a true scaled replica bias (M6 diode at Vgs≈vin with same L as M1, M5/M3 scaled copies of M1/M2) so Vout≈pb=VDD-Vsg inherently. Keep single CS for gm/power efficiency; longer Ln for gain."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (96e-6, 80e-6, 99e-6),   # main branch current
    "Ln":     (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),         # input device L (also M5/M6)
    "Lp":     (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),         # PMOS load / replica diode L
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id (sets Vsg -> Vout)
    "r":      (0.03, 0.02, 0.06),      # replica branch current / I1
    "t1":     (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),       # trim of M6 width (fine Vout trim)
    "t2":     (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),       # trim of M3 width (fine Vout trim)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]
    Ln, Lp = p["Ln"], p["Lp"]

    # PMOS load: size for I1 at chosen gm/Id; its Vsg sets the output DC level
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I1, vds=0.9)
    vsg = m2.vgs
    for _ in range(3):
        m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I1, vds=vsg)
        vsg = m2.vgs
    W2 = m2.W
    vout_t = VDD - vsg

    # Input NMOS: W so that Id(vgs=vin, vds=vout_t) = I1
    W1 = 20.0
    for _ in range(8):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", W1, Ln, vin, vout_t)["Id"]
        W1 = W1 * I1 / max(Id_t, 1e-12)
    W1 = min(max(W1, 0.42), 5000)
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, Ln, vin, vout_t)

    # Reference diode M6 (same L as M1): Vgs ~= vin at iref (its vds = vgs)
    W6 = 2.0
    for _ in range(8):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", W6, Ln, vin, vin)["Id"]
        W6 = W6 * iref / max(Id_t, 1e-12)
    W6 = min(max(W6 * p["t1"], 0.42), 5000)

    # Replica branch: M5 = scaled M1 (gate at ibias ~ vin), M3 = scaled M2 (diode)
    I5 = I1 * p["r"]
    W5 = max(W1 * I5 / I1, 0.42)
    W3 = max(W2 * (W5 / W1) * p["t2"], 0.42)

    op2 = lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsg, VDD - vout_t)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M6", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, Ln)
    n.M("M5", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, Ln)
    n.M("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, Lp)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, Lp)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, Ln)

    gm = op1["gm"]
    gds = op1["gds"] + op2["gds"]
    A = gm / gds
    cout = cl * 1.08
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = VDD * (iref + I5 + I1)
    swing = VDD - op1["vdsat"] - op2["vdsat"] - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": swing, "inverting": 1}
```
